caption:
OUR 6 BEST PLAYERS RIGHT NOW AS POKÉMON. AND ONE OF THEM IS SHINY ✨🎮

6️⃣ Jamison Battle = Inteleon: finds the weak spot and fires. Undrafted, 43.3% from three
5️⃣ Collin Murray-Boyles = Scizor: a body of steel. 1.1 steals, 1.0 blocks a night
4️⃣ Ja'Kobe Walter = Sneasel: it steals eggs, he steals the ball. 1.3 steals a night
3️⃣ Immanuel Quickley = Alakazam: its IQ is 5,000. Ours just goes by IQ. 5.6 assists a night
2️⃣ RJ Barrett = Donphan: once it starts rolling, it can't stop. 21.3 a night
1️⃣ Scottie Barnes = SHINY Mew: so rare it's called a mirage. Our leading scorer at 23.5 a night

Who did we leave out? 👇

facts.claim: Undrafted in the 2024 NBA draft, signed by Toronto July 16, 2024
Scottie Barnes leads the Raptors in scoring this season (No. 1 scorer, leading scorer, 23.5 PPG), ahead of RJ Barrett 21.3 and Immanuel Quickley 17.6
Inteleon (Shield Pokedex): Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
Scizor (Ruby Pokedex): Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks.
Sneasel (Ruby Pokedex): It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
Alakazam (LeafGreen Pokedex): Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.
Donphan (Ruby Pokedex): Once it starts rolling, this Pokemon can't stop very easily.
Mew is a Mythical Pokemon; (Red Pokedex) So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Shiny Pokemon are rare alternate-colour variants.
Ranking positions, not stats: this reel ranks six (6) current Raptors from No. 6 down to 5, 4, 3, 2 and No. 1; the order is our opinion, every player is on the current roster
